newsitem.title: UK: Utd Utilities remains under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Utd Utilities remains under pressure.

text.p: Shares in United Utilities Plc was among the few decliners in the FTSE 100 index on Wednesday as the stock continued to be overshadowed by Monday's departure of chief executive Brian Staples, dealers said.
Shares were down 1/2p at 701 by 0808 GMT in modest volume of less than half a million shares, even as the FTSE 100 leapt as much as 79.7 points.
Dealers noted a report in the Daily Mail that said institutional investors would voice concerns at the management style of chairman Sir Desmond Pitcher at Friday's annual shareholders' meeting.
"There is still some uncertainty around after the chief executive's departure," said one dealer.
United Utilites said on Monday Staples had quit "following a loss of confidence in him by the board," but made no further comment.
However, he said the stock seemed to be supported at around the 700p level.
